entity.name: Oleksandr Shevchuk
entity.description: Author and sole maintainer of vue-quilly, a Vue 3 component and composable for building Quill v2 based rich-text editors. Funding pays for maintenance time: Quill and Vue upgrades, bug fixes, issue triage, documentation and the demo site.

projects.name: vue-quilly
projects.description: Tiny Vue 3 component and composable for building WYSIWYG editors on Quill v2. Imports quill/core only for a minimal bundle, works with HTML and Quill Delta content, ships TypeScript types and supports Nuxt 4 SSR. About 30,000 npm downloads per month.

channels.description: Open Collective, fiscally hosted by Open Source Collective (US 501(c)(6) non-profit). Companies receive an invoice; all spending is public.

plans.name: Sponsor
plans.description: Monthly sponsorship for companies shipping vue-quilly in a product. Logo and link in the README and on the collective page.
